pageProps.title: Jangsangni Makguksu Yangyang Main Branch
pageProps.review: Yangyang Jangsangni Makguksu Yangyang Main Branch offers homemade noodles pulled immediately upon order and refreshing icy dongchimi broth, providing a special taste that changes from bibim to mul-makguksu and the joy of adding extra noodles.
pageProps.content: ## Ordered ```menu { "title": "Dongchimi Mul-makguksu", "rating": 4 } --- The icy dongchimi broth is good. ``` ## Review It takes some time because they pull the noodles themselves when you order, but it's not a problem at all. There was a way to eat it deliciously, so I followed it. There is no separate bibim; you eat it as bibim and then add the icy dongchimi broth they gave you separately to eat it as mul-makguksu. I recommend adding extra noodles! ## Pictures
